messages:
sam: heads-up from AE 9: customer (regional fintech) wants a single purchasable offering: Private VPC + per-tenant throughput guarantees + customer keys + audit export stream. pilot goal: 6w. they want a flat monthly price, not purely usage.

maria: thanks. product question 1: do we treat this as an add-on or a new SKU? sales is pushing for a named product they can quote.

elaine: risk profile: they need region-locking, key custody, and a written SLA for peak windows. They're comfortable with a pilot if we mark any HSM work as "roadmapped".

jon: implementation notes: quick path = Redwood-managed KMS + tenant QoS slices on Dedicated pools -> ~3-4w to standing pilot (no HSM). Full compliance path with customer HSM and hardware attestation -> ~10-12w and operator changes for key wrapping. Dedicated per-tenant GPU pools bumps infra ops overhead significantly.

ben: finance rough: flat-price pilot needs discounting. If we sell a "Compliance Lane" add-on with managed-KMS QoS, we can land ~1.1x uplift on reserved price; HSM + dedicated pools needs ~2x uplift to maintain ~15% margin. I'll run a 3-/6-/12-month model.

legal-bot: legal flags: include data residency commitments, encryption key ownership options (customer-managed vs Redwood-managed with escrow), audit access SLA, and export/regulatory carveouts. For pilot, add explicit limitations on HSM deliverables and acceptance criteria.

ops-bot: ops POV: need per-tenant telemetry (latency, qps, error rate), billing meter events, and a runbook for failover to hosted fallback. Canary plan: start at 2% traffic, escalate to 25% over 72h if error <0.5% and p50 latency within SLO. ETA to add dashboards: ~10 business days if metric feed is prioritized.

maria: proposed commercial structure: "Private Compliance Lane" SKU = base Private reserved fee + compliance add-on (flat monthly). Pilot: 6w, 30% pilot discount, conversion to committed reserved term (min 3mo) on acceptance. Need explicit conversion triggers in contract.

sam: sales asks for a simple quoting line and example invoice numbers. ben pls provide a price sheet by Thu.

jon: tech acceptance criteria (to include in spec): automated smoke test suite, canary thresholds, per-tenant telemetry, validated model matrix for supported quantized runtimes, documented rollback steps.

elaine: short-term compromise for pilot: offer hosted-with-dedicated-peering + managed-KMS + audit exports. This gives network isolation and auditability without HSM. Customer must acknowledge HSM timeline and sign conversion clause.

ben: note on billing: meter both reserved capacity and add-on as flat SKU; need sample usage report for AE to show cost parity vs self-hosting.

legal-bot: I'll draft contract addendum language distinguishing pilot limitations, conversion terms, data residency, and KMS options. Target Wed.

maria: owners: @jon = technical spec + acceptance tests, @ben = price models and invoice examples, @legal-bot = draft addendum, @elaine = customer comms + pilot scope. I'll compile the spec doc and circulate.

sam: scheduling sync Tue 10am PT. please drop any blockers here before EOD Mon.

jon: one more ops thing: if we use QoS slices on shared infra, we must instrument headroom throttles to avoid noisy neighbor SLA breaches. put that in the canary checklist.

maria: good call. final action: consolidate proposals into one page decision memo (tech options, cost delta, timeline, risks) by Mon EOD. i'll upload to #product for review before Tue. :spiral_calendar:
